# Library of Congress

> The Library of Congress preserves and provides access to America's cultural and historical heritage through digital collections, research resources, and educational programs.

As the largest library in the world, the Library of Congress serves Congress, researchers, educators, and the public through its extensive catalog of 20+ million records, specialized research centers, and digital preservation initiatives. The institution operates multiple locations including the Thomas Jefferson Building and Packard Campus, and offers comprehensive reference services, educational materials, and public engagement programs.

## Key Topics

- Digital collections
- Library catalog
- Primary sources
- Research resources

## Discovery & Collections

- [Library of Congress Catalog](https://catalog.loc.gov): Searchable catalog of 20+ million records for books, maps, and digital resources.
- [Discover the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/discover): Main discovery portal for searching millions of digitized items and collections.
- [Home | Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov): Homepage showcasing Library of Congress collections, events, and digital resources.

## Research & Learning

- [Education Resources from the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/education): Educational materials and primary sources for teachers and classrooms.
- [About This Program | Teachers](https://www.loc.gov/teachers): Primary source materials and professional development for educators.
- [Use the Library | Research Centers](https://www.loc.gov/research-centers/use-the-library): Guide to accessing digital resources and specialized research centers.
- [Ask a Librarian](https://ask.loc.gov): Reference service for asking librarians research and collection questions.

## Services & Organization

- [About the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/about): Organizational overview of Library of Congress mission and structure.
- [Services & Programs](https://www.loc.gov/services-and-programs): Overview of Library services, cataloging standards, and preservation programs.
- [Help Resources](https://www.loc.gov/help): Help resources for catalog research, accessibility, and library services.
- [Contact](https://www.loc.gov/contact): Contact information and phone directory for Library of Congress departments.

## Visitor & Community Engagement

- [Visiting the Library](https://www.loc.gov/visit): Visitor information for Thomas Jefferson Building and Packard Campus locations.
- [Connect with the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/connect): Social media and engagement channels for Library of Congress community.
- [Library of Congress Blogs](https://blogs.loc.gov): Collection of Library of Congress blogs featuring stories and cultural history.

## Featured Content

- [Lost 19th century film by Méliès discovered at the Library](https://blogs.loc.gov/loc/2026/02/lost-19th-century-film-by-melies-discovered-at-the-library): Blog post about discovery of lost 1897 Méliès film and preservation efforts.

## Optional
